en: It's a terrible mess, so please come back later.
I'll tell you all about our new products then.
I'll be waiting, so do come by!
Good day. Pardon the intrusion.
You'd think soap is just soap, but there are
so many different kinds of it.
You simply must try our new product, too.
To bring this fight to a quick end,
please, I ask you to help me.
, my master! You honor me.
If this old crone can serve, say the word...
Well now, how strange...
Whatever could this wound be, I wonder.
Command me as you will...
I was quite a tomboy myself when young.
I dreamed I got in a rough-and-tumble fight
like in those days. How funny.
Oh? What do you want with an old woman?
Or are you after some yarn?
I don't sell spun yarn here, mind you.
Good day, old woman.
I only came to look at something unusual.
Hmm, so this is a spinning wheel.
Is that so? Look all you like.
Children come to see me now and then, too.
Children love old tales, you see.
I have an interest in folklore myself.
I'll drop by again, old woman.
Is that so? Come again, then.
This old woman does have a name, Lorna,
but call me whatever you like.
Oh? I can't see well, but it seems someone
I've met before is here. What brings you?
Is that so? I've heard that before.
Come by whenever you like.
It's you, isn't it.
My eyes are poor, but I can still tell
who's come to see me.
Nobody else has come by today.
I've just remembered an interesting tale.
Have you heard of vampires?
Vampires really do exist, you know.
They live hidden among ordinary people.
What is it? Come wanting a story, have you?
Sorry, but I must beg off today.
I ache all over, somehow.
In the old days, when my head or limbs
suddenly ached, something bad always came.
Is something bad drawing near, I wonder.
! It's you.
There's power dwelling in your name.
I can feel a strange power.
You're not like ordinary folk, I feel.
My granddaughter's visiting me tomorrow.
She loves old tales. Care to listen, too?
Oh? Who's there?
My old eyes don't see too well.
And my legs are bad, so I can't come to you.
You don't seem a bad sort. If you need me,
come on over here.
The same person again, eh? What is it?
Oh, it's you. Back again, are you?
This is my resting time, you know.
Old folk need a lot of sleep.
Let me sleep.
Or the Reaper will come for me sooner.
Back again, are you? Come on in.
You like hearing old stories, do you?
Old tales hold truth in them, after all...
I can't think visiting an old woman is fun,
but come again.
Dangerous humans turn up in odd places.
Vampire lore being spread around could well
become a problem.
Best to make her my servant, and soon.
note: No speaker tag (player's thought after the folklore scene); 'her' = Lorna.

en: I doubt she'll be of any use in battle...
So long as she stays out of my way, that'll do.
note: No speaker tag; player's thought about Lorna as a new servant.

en: Hello, ma'am.
I thought I saw something unusual here...
Hmm, so this is a spinning wheel.
